name: Modular Engine Cylinder 1x1
description: Attach a cylinder to a crankshafts outer surface to produce power for an engine. The cylinder requires a manifold to move air, fuel, and exhaust through the cylinder. Cylinders that are chained directly adjacent to each other can share a single manifold.

logicNodes.label: Composite Data
logicNodes.description: Outputs data from the cylinder. (Value 1 : Air Volume) (Value 2 : Fuel Volume) (Value 3 : Temperature)
